interface.name: org_archphene_gpu_present_manager_v1
interface.description: This private protocol associates a resource accepted through Archphene's authenticated APHB side channel with one exact wl_surface commit. Binding this interface does not grant access to an AHardwareBuffer.

request.name: get_surface_binding

description.summary: bind one identity stream to one surface

request.description: A wl_surface may have at most one live GPU presentation binding.

interface.name: org_archphene_gpu_surface_v1
interface.description: set_resource is double-buffered and applies on the next wl_surface.commit. A standard wl_buffer attachment without set_resource replaces the current GPU identity. A standard buffer detach also clears the identity. A damage-only commit retains the current identity.

request.name: set_resource

description.summary: set the resource for the next surface commit

request.description: The helper generation, resource ID, and fence sequence must match one already authenticated APHB Present frame. The 64-bit fence sequence is encoded as unsigned high and low words.

description.summary: clear the identity on the next surface commit

entry.name: invalid_identity
entry.summary: identity is zero, stale, unknown, or cross-generation

entry.name: stale_fence
entry.summary: fence sequence does not strictly increase
